runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_0a56f90f7ffe3W2uWr4rsjpnE1] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Here are the first-seen block arrival times for **mainnet on June 20, 2026**:

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **Total slots** | 7,180 (slots 14,590,799 → 14,597,998) |
| **Time range** | 2026-06-20 00:00:11 → 23:59:59 UTC |
| **Avg arrival time** | 1,710 ms |
| **Median arrival** | 1,453 ms |
| **P95 arrival** | 3,126 ms |
| **Min arrival** | 141 ms |
| **Max arrival** | 5,249 ms |
| **Total observations** | ~1.13 million (from all reporting nodes) |

The `arrival_time_ms` is the minimum `seen_slot_start_diff` per slot — how quickly the block was first seen by any node after the slot started.

[Turn 2 | session=ses_0a56f90f7ffe3W2uWr4rsjpnE1] Plot the distribution of those arrival times as a chart.
The chart was generated and uploaded successfully — view it here:

**URL:** http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/cfcf0a7d412d/cfbfa198-7fe1-43ee-9f9e-8961df082fa5/arrival_distribution.png

The histogram shows the distribution of per-slot minimum arrival times across 7,180 mainnet blocks on June 20, 2026, with most blocks arriving within ~2 seconds of the slot start.
